note — the bold part is what the card te: The future is werden in second place and the infinitive at the end, like a modal.
du wirst: werden is irregular, wirst with no d.
er/es wird. morgen first, wird second, regnen last.
wir werden + the infinitive.
ihr werdet.

English: They **are going to get married** next year.
note — the bold part is what the card te: sie werden … heiraten. nächstes Jahr: next year.
bald: soon. es wird … schneien.
The future often makes a guess or a promise: bestimmt, surely.
wird … sein: a guess about now or later.

English: In the future I **will live** in Italy.
German: In der Zukunft **werde** ich in Italien **wohnen**.
note — the bold part is what the card te: werde second, wohnen last.
du wirst … bestehen.
wer takes wird: the er form.
With a time word, German usually uses the present for the future.

English: We'**ll see** each other next week.
note — the bold part is what the card te: The present again: nächste Woche already says when.

English: He **is going to be** a teacher.
note — the bold part is what the card te: werden on its own means to become.
werden + adjective: to get, to become.
man: people in general. It takes the er form of the verb: darf.

English: How do **you** say that in German?
note — the bold part is what the card te: man sagt: one says. auf Deutsch: in German.

English: In Germany **people** eat a lot of bread.
note — the bold part is what the card te: man for what people in general do.

English: **Someone** is standing in front of the door.
note — the bold part is what the card te: jemand: someone, with the er form.
jemand also means anyone in a question.
As an object, jemand usually takes -en: jemanden.
niemand: nobody. No extra nicht.
German says I know nobody: niemanden as the object.
niemand + the future: wird … wissen.
etwas: something.
etwas also means anything in a question.
nichts: nothing, never nicht etwas.
nichts as the object.
alle: everybody, with a plural verb.
alle before a plural noun: all.
alles: everything, with a singular verb.
für + alles.
